youtube.title: The Alcatraz Escape: Three Men Who Vanished Into the Bay (Full Case File)
youtube.description:
On the morning of 12 June 1962, guards at Alcatraz found three dummy heads in three beds. Frank Morris and the brothers John and Clarence Anglin had spent months digging through their cell vents with spoons and a drill made from a vacuum-cleaner motor, built a raft from more than 50 raincoats, and pushed off into San Francisco Bay. Their bodies were never found. The FBI closed the case in 1979. The U.S. Marshals never have. This is the complete case file: the plan, the night, what the FBI found, the 2013 letter, and what the evidence really says about whether they made it.

📂 Case File #011: The Alcatraz Escape — full documentary
